stories.headline: GTA VI begins global rollout as gamers enter Vice City
stories.summary: After 13 years, Rockstar's blockbuster unlocks at midnight in each market, starting in New Zealand, to rave early reviews.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen in first three-way summit
stories.summary: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia sit down together for the first time, with nuclear arms, Iran and Ukraine on the table.

stories.headline: Crimean Bridge hit a third time this week, traffic halted
stories.summary: Russia's installed governor in Crimea said the bridge was attacked again; damage is being assessed, days after its road span collapsed.

stories.headline: Van Gogh sells for record $190.4m after Nazi-era row settled
stories.summary: Blossoming Chestnut Trees smashed the artist's auction record at Sotheby's, a day after a deal with the Fischer heirs.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3bn in biggest IPO of all time
stories.summary: Shares priced at $83 value the Claude maker at about $1.5tn; it starts trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday as ANT.

stories.headline: World court delivers Myanmar genocide verdict today
stories.summary: The ICJ rules in The Gambia's case over the 2017 crackdown that drove 700,000+ Rohingya to Bangladesh.

also_today: EU proposes a €45bn Ukraine loan, repayable only once Russia pays reparations.
Israeli tanks cross Gaza's Yellow Line in a rare ground operation; Hamas calls it a ceasefire breach.
Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries, 251-11, set to be the first Black House Speaker.
note: Real world news of 19 November 2026, verified 19 Nov 2026 against Reuters, AP, NASA and Pew Research Center reporting.
